user.title: Connect to SMS Gateway for Android
user.description: Enter the Local Server details shown in the app.

data_description.message_path: Documented endpoint is /messages. Older app versions only expose /message; the integration switches automatically if needed.

reconfigure.title: Change gateway connection
reconfigure.description: Update the address, port or credentials. Entities and their history are kept.

error.cannot_connect: Gateway unreachable. Check the IP address, the port and that Local Server is running.
error.invalid_auth: Credentials rejected by the Local Server.
error.unsupported_version: The app reports version {version}, but {minimum} or later is required: MMS sending does not exist in earlier versions.

data_description.default_recipient: Creates a notify entity that sends to this number.
data_description.webhook_url: Leave empty to use the Home Assistant external URL. Must be HTTPS with a valid certificate: the secure app build rejects http:// and bare IP addresses.
data_description.check_updates: Queries the GitHub releases page every 12 hours. This is the integration's only outbound call — disable it to stay fully local.
data_description.signing_key: From the app, Settings > Webhooks > Signing Key. When set, incoming webhooks whose HMAC-SHA256 signature does not match are rejected. Leave empty to accept unsigned requests.

send_sms.name: Send SMS
send_sms.description: Send a text message through the gateway.

send_mms.name: Send MMS
send_mms.description: Send a multimedia message with one or more attachments.

attachments.name: Attachments
attachments.description: Absolute paths, inside an allowed folder.

webhook_url_unavailable.title: SMSGateway: no HTTPS webhook URL
webhook_url_unavailable.description:
The secure build of the SMS Gateway app only accepts webhook URLs served over HTTPS with a valid certificate, so an internal http:// address or a bare IP is rejected.

Set an external URL in Settings > System > Network, or fill in the webhook URL override in the SMSGateway options. Sending messages keeps working; only inbound SMS and MMS are affected.
